page_title: National Standard GB28181--Local Configuration Import Registration Platform
page_content:
[TOC]



### Prerequisites:
- The device network can access the Internet normally, for example: 4G dial-up is successful or wired network routing is successful or WiFi connection is successful, refer to the "Function Usage">>>"Network Function" article introduction!

### Operation steps:
1. Download this configuration file template [config.zip](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=00a0857c2916c0223fbb6db3a546c164 "[config.zip") and unzip it locally
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=439939d4aeed81dabab0f3edc233bfa4)
1. Open it with a text editing tool and fill in the parameters such as "Open function" "Server IP" "Server port" "Authentication username" "Authentication password", refer to the parameter notes below
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=884a6c34646a2ad2f5048d7e962e9aae)
> Parameter Notes:
ucFD_Enable="1":Function enabled and sub-stream uploaded;"0"Function disabled;"129"Function enabled and main stream uploaded
ucFD_Version="1":GB28181 version 2022;"0" GB28181 version 2016
ucFD_TcpSip="0":sip UDP protocol;"1"sip TCP protocol
ucFD_TcpMedia="0":media UDP protocol;"1"media TCP protocol
ucFD_AutoGps="0":location data needs to be subscribed;"1"location data is sent automatically
ucFD_TalkChn="0":voice channel auto;"1"voice channel CHN
strFD_Manufacturer="BBC":device manufacturer
strFD_ModelName="M51Hv":device model
strFD_ServerIp="139.9.251.220":server IP or domain name
usFD_ServerPort="6608":server port
strFD_ServerID="34017101041328000012":server ID number
strFD_ServerDomain="8000012":server domain
strFD_DeviceId="281812016":device ID number
usFD_DevicePort="5888":device port
strFD_DeviceUser="34017101041328000012":authentication username
strFD_DevicePass="123456":authentication password
SUBDEVID_0 strFD_LensId="":configure the first channel ID number
SUBDEVID_1 strFD_LensId="" configure the second channel ID number, and so on

1. Unlock the device and remove the hard disk or SD card storage. Use a hard disk reader or SD card reader to insert it into the computer and open the root directory of the first partition of the storage
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=6ea4e92280df79c27ff34850f25ad924)
1. Copy the config file you just edited and saved to this directory, disconnect the device, insert the device and lock it
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b3550241b8db8d4f2e42c5e59e2ad72f)
1. When the device is powered on, it will automatically import the configuration and restart. The configuration will take effect after the restart
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=faafed503debbf0c06e273c7e9ad9521)
1. Enter the device system's WEB interface to check if the connection is successful, or check if the platform is online
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=427e09fa0b2403a310c2096f4aacd252)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b4084f4f396cf41144778979f1dc1fbd)
